input_constraints: production palette {0,1,2,4} with pairwise-disjoint horizontal extents
three distinct starting top rows so every anchor setting changes the answer
retained sampler uses one copied shape across colors so every setting is total
invariant_reasoning: group every nonzero cell by its color
read the chosen anchor color's original top row
translate each color vertically as one object while preserving columns and shape
make every color top equal the anchor top
limitations: This task-local prototype does not modify production generation or approval.
Retained inputs use copied shapes to avoid undefined clipping under alternate anchors.
Identifiability is checked against the two declared alternate anchor settings, not every imaginable program.

programs.source:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((blue-cells (find-color g 1))
                  (blue-top (min-of fst blue-cells))
                  (all-cells (flatmap (lambda (r)
                                        (flatmap (lambda (c)
                                                   (let ((v (at g r c)))
                                                     (if (!= v 0)
                                                         (list (list r c v))
                                                         (list))))
                                                 (range 0 w)))
                                      (range 0 h)))
                  (blank (cellmap g (r c v) 0)))
             (reduce (lambda (grid cell)
                       (let* ((kr (first cell))
                              (kc (second cell))
                              (v (third cell))
                              (color-top (min-of fst (find-color g v)))
                              (shift (- blue-top color-top))
                              (nr (+ kr shift)))
                         (if (and (>= nr 0) (< nr h)) (set-cell grid nr kc v) grid)))
                     blank
                     all-cells)))))
